definition.en: The Universal Postal Union (UPU) is a specialized agency of the United Nations that coordinates postal policies among member nations to ensure a global postal system.
definition.hi: The Universal Postal Union (UPU) is a specialized agency of the United Nations that coordinates postal policies among member nations to ensure a global postal system.

importanceInUpsc.en: For UPSC GS-3, the UPU is significant as it represents international cooperation in trade and logistics, impacting the global supply chain. Understanding its role helps in analyzing how India integrates its domestic postal infrastructure with international standards to facilitate e-commerce and trade.
